drivers: PitchBook: Market expects OpenAI IPO delay to 2027.
Forbes: Growing skepticism on frontier AI economics.
OpenAI in talks to give 5% equity to US government.
en.why_matters: An OpenAI IPO would be a landmark event for the AI industry, setting a precedent for valuation and public market appetite for frontier AI companies. Its timing reflects broader market conditions and investor confidence in AI's long-term profitability.
en.bull_case: Stronger-than-expected revenue growth or a breakthrough product could accelerate an IPO before 2027.
en.bear_case: Worsening AI bubble concerns and complex government stake negotiations will likely push the IPO past 2027.
